chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet atmospheric entrance: a pad breathes in, dew drips tick, a single glassy bell sounds the first notes of the theme and its echo answers from far away}
positive_styles: glassy bell lead with a slow singing melody
faint counter-bell echoing the melody a bar later a fifth higher
breathy sustained pad with cathedral reverb
sparse soft taps and dew-shimmer swells
mysterious glowing dark deep-forest dungeon, quiet wonder with a thread of unease

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the slow bell melody rises through the Lydian raised fourth and hangs there, luminous; the counter-bell echoes each phrase a bar later, like glimmers answering across the dark}
positive_styles: glassy bell lead with a slow singing melody
faint counter-bell echoing the melody a bar later a fifth higher
breathy sustained pad with cathedral reverb
sparse soft taps and dew-shimmer swells

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Reprise]
{the melody again, now with the arpeggios shimmering underneath and the pad swelling, deeper into the wood}

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: the drained grey ground, the glow gone out; E minor, the arpeggios stop, a low hollow bell line moves slowly over the bass pedal, uneasy and sorrowful, then one bright glint returns}

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the glassy bell melody returns with its echoes; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
